prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1006; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the above-named individual in connection with injuries sustained in a motor vehicle collision that occurred at a controlled intersection, in which your insured's vehicle struck the side of our client's vehicle. Our client has sustained significant injuries and is currently receiving medical treatment. Please direct all further communication regarding this claim to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We request that you provide a complete copy of the declarations page for the policy in force at the time of the collision, including the bodily injury and property damage liability limits, together with confirmation of any other coverage that may apply. We also ask that you place a hold on and preserve all evidence relating to this incident, including photographs, vehicle data, dash camera or telematics records, recorded statements, claim file materials, and any repair or total loss documentation. Please confirm in writing within ten days that you have received this letter and that the requested materials are being preserved.
